resources.string: Your contribution helps us run the secure servers that power your safety features—cloud backup, location sharing, evidence storage, and emergency alerts.
Secure Servers: Encrypted cloud storage for your evidence (photos, audio, video)
Live Location: Real-time location sharing with emergency contacts
Instant Alerts: SMS and push notifications to your contacts
24/7 Support: Maintenance and updates to keep the app safe and reliable
Send any amount (₹10 onwards) using any UPI app
Open any UPI app (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM) and scan this code to donate

Every rupee helps us protect more women. Your donation is secure and will be used only for server maintenance and safety features.\n\nNo amount is too small. Together, we make safety accessible to everyone.
• All donations go directly to server costs • No middlemen or commissions • Monthly updates on app improvements • Your data is never sold or shared • Open-source codebase (available on GitHub)
If you have any questions about donations or want to sponsor a feature, please reach out.
